expectation: The pancreas will be fitted to the digestive tube.

effect: The digestive organs are fitted, completing the first goal; the meal still needs to be broken down.
reason: Salivary amylase is shown beside starch chains, making it a clear starting point for digesting the bread.
expectation: The amylase will begin breaking the starch into smaller carbohydrates.

effect: Salivary amylase produced shorter starch chains; further digestion is needed for absorption.
reaction: The first digestion step was predictable.
reason: The remaining starch-digesting enzymes are shown at the small intestine and should continue breaking down the chains.
expectation: The shorter chains will be broken down into absorbable sugars.

effect: The starch is now individual glucose molecules; protein and fat still need digestion.
reaction: The progression from starch chains to glucose was clear.
reason: The protein-digesting enzymes are shown alongside protein chains and should break down the protein food.
expectation: The protein will be broken into smaller absorbable components.

effect: Protein digestion produced amino acids; fat remains to be broken down.
reason: Bile and lipase are shown breaking down fat droplets.
expectation: The fat will be broken into smaller components suitable for absorption.

effect: Fat digestion produced fatty acids and monoglycerides, completing the remaining goal; the result also distinguishes bile’s dispersal role from lipase’s digestive action.
reaction: That distinction was a useful clarification.

mostWorthwhile.text: Digesting the fat was most worthwhile: the planned picture and explanation distinguish dispersing droplets from breaking fat molecules apart.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the three organs was clear but repetitive; each was simply placed in its named slot.

surprise.text: The fat result made explicit that bile is not an enzyme, despite being paired with lipase as one item.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt purposeless, although the combined bile-and-lipase item initially obscured their separate roles until the result explained them.

continue.text: I would continue: the clear progression from starch to glucose and the distinction between bile and lipase make me curious how absorption will be connected to the digestive system.
